entries.target: A medium range status skill that applies to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Constrict time at the present junction, and invoke a Veil of Compressed Time to protect you for 10 seconds, decreasing the damage and DoT damage you take by 40%, and increasing your Haste by 15%. In the presence of a Temporal Rift, the Daybreak Radiance heals you, applying a 10 second HoT based on its stacks. If your opponent is unaffected by a Temporal Shift, they become trapped in Twilight Shadows, taking rapid damage over time for 12 seconds.
notes: Applies Veil of Compressed Time, increasing Damage and DoT Resistances by 40% and Haste by 15%, lasts 10 seconds.
If Temporal Rift is present on the caster, applies Daybreak Radiance, a 10 second HoT based on the number of Temporal Rift stacks.
If Temporal Shift is not present on the target, apply Twilight Shadows, a rapid DoT dealing 3600% Magic damage over 12 seconds.

entries.target: A medium range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Warp space and time around your foe to inflict unavoidable damage. If your foe is affected by Temporal Shift, they become trapped in the Prior Dawn for 12 seconds, increasing their DoT damage taken by 30% and decreasing damage dealt by 10%. If your foe is unaffected by Temporal Shift, they become trapped in the Subsequent Dusk for 12 seconds, increasing their DoT damage taken by 60%, and decreasing damage dealt by 20%.
notes: If Temporal Shift is present on the target, applies Prior Dawn, which decreases target's DoT Resistance by 30% and outgoing damage by 10%.
If Temporal Rift is not present on the caster, applies Subsequent Dusk to the target, which decreases target's DoT Resistance by 60% and outgoing damage by 20%.
